# Psalm 53 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For the music director. A meditation of David, to be sung to the tune of 'Mahalath.'

**2** Only fools say in their hearts, 'There is no God.' They are corrupt, and their actions are evil; not one of them does good!

**3** God looks down from heaven on the entire human race; He looks to see if anyone is truly wise, if anyone seeks God.

**4** But no, all have turned away; all have become corrupt. No one does good, not a single one!

**5** Will those who do evil never learn? They devour my people as if they were eating bread; they never call on God.

**6** Terror will grip them, terror like they have never known before. God will scatter the bones of your enemies. You will put them to shame, for God has rejected them.

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **53:6**: The key difference from Psalm 14: this version emphasizes military defeat of enemies. Same theology, different application.

— PNEUMA
